messages:
sam: heads-up — after the 2026-11-12 runtime rollout were seeing increased tail latency on long-sequence chat traffic in Dedicated pools (seq=1024). p99 climbed noticeably on a few customer routes.

perf-ci: snapshot: baseline(2026-11-11) p99=79ms -> post-roll(2026-11-12) p99=90ms (+14%). bench params: seq=1024, batch=1..4, default kv-caching=disabled/cold in harness.

elaine: can we narrow to a commit range? also need warm vs cold kv split and batching distribution.

sam: bisect points to the selector tweak commit range a8f3d2 -> c0b7e9 that altered kernel preference: prefers fused-fma-flash variant for mid-long seq when batch<=4 and continuous_batching=false.

nate: quick profiling (nvprof + runtime traces): fused path shows higher launch latency and extra cudaMemcpy setup on KV miss flows. sample timeline:
```
launch_fused_attn            47.3ms
kv_miss_prefetch_handler    15.2ms
cuda_async_memcopy_setup     10.6ms
```
cold-KV adds ~12-18ms to worst-case tail. Also some evidence of stream contention when multiple small kernels are launched on same stream.

maria: repro steps on g5.2x: 
```
./bench/micro --model gpt-s --seq 1024 --batch 2 --kv=forced-cold --selector=auto --iters=250
```
quick results:
 - selector=auto (fused chosen): p50=37.1ms p99=98.6ms
 - selector=force-paged: p50=35.4ms p99=86.9ms
 - selector=force-fused-warmonly: p50=36.8ms p99=89.6ms
median similar; tails worse with fused when KV cold.

sam: condensed hypothesis: fused variant optimizes compute but has higher ephemeral kernel-launch and prefetch choreography for KV misses; small batches amplify kernel-launch variance and cause worse p99. paged path has cheaper launch+prefetch behavior.

elaine: mitigation suggestions: (1) selector heuristic to prefer paged/fallback when routes observed kv_hit_rate is low, (2) add telemetry for selector_choice + kv_hit_rate buckets + per-route p50/p95/p99 by selector so we can validate.

nate: heuristic sketch: 
```
// last_N window of requests per route
if (seq >= 512 && batch <= 4 && kv_recent_hit_rate < 0.6) {
  return KERNEL_PAGED_ATTENTION;
}
return choose_best_by_estimate();
```
Tune 0.6 via microbench matrix. Also add a request-local kv_cold_hint driven by last_100.kv_miss_ratio > 0.4 so selector can react fast.

maria: running matrix: kv_hit_rate=[0.0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0] x batch=[1,2,4] x seq=[512,1024]; uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/20261112/attn-selector-matrix/

perf-ci: matrix highlights:
 - kv=0.0,batch=2,seq=1024: fused.p99=98.9ms, paged.p99=86.3ms
 - kv=1.0,batch=2,seq=1024: fused.p99=81.8ms, paged.p99=82.0ms
Conclusion: paged is strictly better for cold-KV tails; fused is fine when KV is warm.

sam: short-term plan: revert selector change on Dedicated images for canary, land selector_kv_guard behind a flag with threshold 0.6-0.65, and add telemetry panels. long-term: reduce fused kernels cold-KV startup cost and investigate stream isolation / pre-launch warmups.

elaine: rollout steps:
 - revert commit c0b7e9 for Dedicated canary (5% traffic) tonight
 - land selector_kv_guard behind runtime flag + add telemetry metrics (runtime.selector_choice, runtime.kv_hit_rate_bucket, per_route.p99_by_selector)
 - add smoke tests and microbench gate
 - monitor 30-60m, then promote or revert.

dev-ops-bot: scheduled canary: ded-prod-canary @ 2026-11-13T02:45:00Z -> 5% traffic. CI gates: microbench matrix + e2e smoke.

nate: also adding a lightweight local guard: maintain sliding-window last_100 kv_miss_ratio and expose kv_cold_hint boolean to selector; avoids waiting on global telemetry.

maria: local microbench with kv_guard threshold=0.62 shows: cold rows p99 reduced by ~9-11ms when guard triggers. Logs + flamegraphs uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/20261112/attn-selector-logs/logs.tar.gz

perf-bot: PR opened DRT-3421 selector_kv_guard.patch (includes unit tests and perf smoke). CI green.

dev-ops-bot: canary running (5% traffic): 30m snapshot -> preliminary p99 delta = +0.3% on observed routes. Awaiting 2h full window.

sam: if canary final < +1% we promote heuristic to 100% for Dedicated and keep the selector change reverted. If not, full revert. Schedule follow-up review 09:00 PST tomorrow for next steps and long-term perf work.

elaine: adding Grafana panels now, will post links here once ready.

maria: leaving raw artifacts and perf notes in PR and S3. planning further micro-optimizations: async prefetch of KV for fused path and pinned memory staging to reduce memcpy setup latencies.

nate: also instrument kernel-launch histograms per-variant to see distribution and detect contention.

sam: thanks all. keeping thread open until post-canary verification. :thumbsup:
